description: Asks to refund a sale IN FULL. The call does nothing yet: it returns `approveUrl`, which the developer approves in the panel (once, within 24 hours). Once approved the money goes back through Stripe and the buyer loses the purchase at once (credits and paid bookings too; the app receives a "revoked" purchase event). Partial refunds, and refunding or cancelling a subscription (not_refundable here), are done in the Stripe Dashboard (neblla_payments_account dashboard_link). More: neblla_get_llms tools/sales

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

name: neblla_sales
title: Refund or cancel sales
